+import json, os, time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import cv2
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_brush import Session
+
+ROOT = Path('/app/output')
+INST = '/app/instance.json'
+IM = np.asarray(Image.open('/app/target.png').convert('RGB'), np.uint8)
+DATA = json.load(open(INST))
+PALETTE = np.array([w['rgb'] for w in DATA['wells']['wells']], np.float32)
+PAL_LAB = cv2.cvtColor(PALETTE[None], cv2.COLOR_RGB2LAB)[0]
+
+
+def lab(im):
+    return cv2.cvtColor(np.asarray(im, np.float32) / 255, cv2.COLOR_RGB2LAB)
+
+
+def nearest(rgb):
+    val = lab(np.asarray(rgb, np.uint8)[None, None])[0, 0]
+    return int(np.argmin(np.sum((PAL_LAB - val) ** 2, axis=1)))
+
+
+class Painter:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.s = Session(instance=INST, render=False)
+        self.p = self.s.primitives()
+        self.wells = self.s.wells()
+        self.loaded = None
+        self.n = 0
+        self.started = time.time()
+        self.s.record_start()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def xy(X, Y):
+        return .01359 - .001 * Y, .11359 - .001 * X
+
+    def move(self, X, Y, z, speed=.18, settle=0):
+        x, y = self.xy(X, Y)
+        return self.p['move_tip']([x, y, z], speed=speed, settle=settle)
+
+    def dip(self, color):
+        if self.loaded == color:
+            return
+        x, y = self.wells[color]['center_xy']
+        self.p['move_tip']([x, y, .052], speed=.28, settle=2)
+        self.p['move_tip']([x, y, .024], speed=.06, settle=3)
+        self.p['move_tip']([x, y, .052], speed=.12, settle=2)
+        self.loaded = color
+
+    def line(self, X0, Y0, X1, Y1, color, press=7, speed=.11):
+        self.dip(color)
+        self.move(X0, Y0, .050, settle=2)
+        self.move(X0, Y0, .020 - .001 * press, speed=.06, settle=3)
+        self.move(X1, Y1, .020 - .001 * press, speed=speed, settle=2)
+        self.move(X1, Y1, .050, speed=.10, settle=2)
+        self.n += 1
+        if self.n % 20 == 0:
+            print('stroke', self.n, 'steps', self.s.n_steps, 'time', round(time.time()-self.started, 1), flush=True)
+
+    def finish(self, tag='trajectory'):
+        acts = self.s.record_stop()
+        self.s.save_trajectory(acts, str(ROOT / f'{tag}.npz'))
+        Image.fromarray(self.s.canvas()).save(ROOT / f'{tag}.png')
+        print('saved', tag, len(acts), len(self.s.strokes()), 'coverage', float((self.s.ink() >= .5)[36:-36,36:-36].mean()), flush=True)
+        score = self.s.score()
+        print('score', score, flush=True)
+
+
+def base(p):
+    blur = cv2.GaussianBlur(IM, (0, 0), 8)
+    rows = np.arange(5, 226, 6)
+    for j, Y in enumerate(rows):
+        v = int(Y * 1024 / 227.18)
+        rgb = np.median(blur[v, 36:-36], axis=0).astype(np.uint8)
+        c = nearest(rgb)
+        if j % 2:
+            p.line(4, Y, 223, Y, c, press=8, speed=.11)
+        else:
+            p.line(223, Y, 4, Y, c, press=8, speed=.11)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    p = Painter()
+    base(p)
+    p.finish('base')
*** End Patch";
